context: Naoko vents about a truck blocking deliveries; Daichi helps.
purpose: Aunt venting about everyday nuisance naturally.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 大ちゃん、トラックが、店の前で止まってしもた!
lines.en: Daichi, a truck has stopped right in front of the shop!
lines.style: animated Kansai aunt voice, bright warm exasperated delivery carefully

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: えっ、バックして、どけてもらえへんの?
lines.en: Eh — can't they back up and clear it?
lines.style: soft Kansai husband voice, warm engaged delivery carefully

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: それが、運転手、おらへんねん。困るわ。
lines.en: Thing is, the driver's not around. It's a hassle.
lines.style: frustrated Kansai aunt voice, bright warm honest delivery carefully

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 正面以外、入口、ないもんな。
lines.en: There's no entrance besides the front, after all.
lines.style: gentle Kansai husband voice, soft warm sympathetic delivery carefully

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: 誰かに、相談した方がええかな?
lines.style: soft Kansai aunt voice, warm engaged delivery carefully

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 俺、近所の人に、声かけてくるわ。
lines.style: warm Kansai husband voice, soft warm helpful delivery carefully

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.style: warm Kansai aunt voice, bright warm grateful delivery carefully
